description: Effective communication with the assistant: context-first prompting, phased work from requirements to design to tasks, iterative refinement, examples, explicit constraints, role framing, validation and trade-off exploration. Use when a request needs a prompt built or repaired — "how do I prompt for this", "the answer ignores my instructions", "make it produce a spec" — or when a previous answer came back generic and the next attempt has to be better.
